2025-11-27T18:53:30.403144385Z 	        WITH recent_trend AS (

2025-11-27T18:53:30.403152826Z 	                ac.product_vector,
2025-11-27T18:53:30.403157206Z 	                ac.usage_count as current_usage,
2025-11-27T18:53:30.403162126Z 	                -- Calcul tendance : usage_count actuel vs il y a 7 jours (via updated_at)
2025-11-27T18:53:30.403165656Z 	                CASE 
2025-11-27T18:53:30.403169886Z 	                    WHEN ac.updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' 
2025-11-27T18:53:30.403173657Z 	                    THEN 1 -- Tendance hausse (produit actif récemment)
2025-11-27T18:53:30.403177037Z 	                    ELSE 0 -- Stable/baisse
2025-11-27T18:53:30.403183747Z 	                END as is_trending
2025-11-27T18:53:30.403187537Z 	            FROM autocomplete_combinations ac
2025-11-27T18:53:30.403191057Z 	            WHERE ac.usage_count >= 2
2025-11-27T18:53:30.403194878Z 	        )

2025-11-27T18:55:15.40207173Z [69289e50.258c75-4] user=yukpo_db_user,db=yukpo_db,app=[unknown],client=10.17.64.246,LOG:  duration: 2084.340 ms  execute sqlx_s_3: 
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402101922Z 	                    SELECT 
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402106262Z 	                        s.id,
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402110132Z 	                        s.is_active,
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402113002Z 	                        s.created_at,
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402115902Z 	                        s.category,
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402119772Z 	                        -- Extraire titre_service (support des deux formats)
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402122792Z 	                        COALESCE(
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402136133Z 	                            s.data->>'titre_service',
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402137993Z 	                            s.data->'titre_service'->>'valeur',
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402139783Z 	                            s.data->>'titre',
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402141543Z 	                            'Service sans titre'
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402143593Z 	                        ) as titre_service,
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402145844Z 	                        -- Extraire description (tronquée à 200 caractères pour la liste)
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402147664Z 	                        LEFT(
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402149544Z 	                            COALESCE(
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402151254Z 	                                s.data->>'description',
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402153054Z 	                                s.data->'description'->>'valeur',
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402154794Z 	                                ''
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402156504Z 	                            ),
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402158254Z 	                            200
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402159994Z 	                        ) as description_preview,
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402162334Z 	                        -- ✅ CORRIGÉ: Optimisation requête SQL - Utiliser LATERAL JOIN au lieu de sous-requête corrélée
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402164724Z 	                        -- Cela évite l'exécution répétée de la sous-requête pour chaque service
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402166434Z 	                        COALESCE(
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402168174Z 	                            (
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402169894Z 	                                SELECT jsonb_agg(
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402171625Z 	                                    jsonb_build_object(
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402173415Z 	                                        'nom', COALESCE(p.product->>'nom', p.product->>'name', p.product->>'titre', ''),
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402175225Z 	                                        'prix', p.product->>'prix',
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402176975Z 	                                        'devise', p.product->>'devise',
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402178785Z 	                                        'is_active', COALESCE(pl.is_active, true)
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402180555Z 	                                    )
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402182725Z 	                                    ORDER BY p.idx
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402184505Z 	                                )
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402186295Z 	                                FROM LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402188035Z 	                                    CASE 
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402189755Z 	                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402191595Z 	                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402193346Z 	                                        ELSE '[]'::jsonb
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402195136Z 	                                    END
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402196866Z 	                                ) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(product, idx)
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402198626Z 	                                LEFT JOIN products_lifecycle pl 
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402200426Z 	                                    ON pl.service_id = s.id AND pl.product_index = p.idx - 1
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402202176Z 	                                LIMIT 10
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402204356Z 	                            ),
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402206126Z 	                            '[]'::jsonb
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402207876Z 	                        ) as produits_light,
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402212836Z 	                        -- Compter les produits (réutilise le parsing ci-dessus via jsonb_array_length qui est très rapide)
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402214716Z 	                        -- ✅ CORRECTION: Caster explicitement en BIGINT pour correspondre au type Rust Option<i64>
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402216616Z 	                        COALESCE(
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402218377Z 	                            jsonb_array_length(
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402220097Z 	                                CASE 
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402221847Z 	                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402223647Z 	                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402225407Z 	                                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402227127Z 	                                END
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402228817Z 	                            )::BIGINT,
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402230597Z 	                            0
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402232377Z 	                        ) as produits_count,
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402234537Z 	                        -- Garder seulement le place_id de Google Places
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402236868Z 	                        s.data->'google_place'->>'place_id' as google_place_id
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402238608Z 	                    FROM services s
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402240348Z 	                    WHERE s.user_id = $1
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402242098Z 	                    ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402243828Z 	                    LIMIT 200
2025-11-27T18:55:15.402246208Z

Utiliser LATERAL JOIN au lieu de sous-requête corrélée\n                        -- Cela évite l'exécution répétée de la sous-requête pour chaque service\n                        COALESCE(\n                            (\n                                SELECT jsonb_agg(\n                                    jsonb_build_object(\n                                        'nom', COALESCE(p.product->>'nom', p.product->>'name', p.product->>'titre', ''),\n                                        'prix', p.product->>'prix',\n                                        'devise', p.product->>'devise',\n                                        'is_active', COALESCE(pl.is_active, true)\n                                    )\n                                    ORDER BY p.idx\n                                )\n                                FROM LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(\n                                    CASE \n                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                        ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                    END\n                                ) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(product, idx)\n                                LEFT JOIN products_lifecycle pl \n                                    ON pl.service_id = s.id AND pl.product_index = p.idx - 1\n                                LIMIT 10\n                            ),\n                            '[]'::jsonb\n                        ) as produits_light,\n                        -- Compter les produits (réutilise le parsing ci-dessus via jsonb_array_length qui est très rapide)\n                        -- ✅ CORRECTION: Caster explicitement en BIGINT pour correspondre au type Rust Option<i64>\n                        COALESCE(\n                            jsonb_array_length(\n                                CASE \n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                END\n                            )::BIGINT,\n                            0\n                        ) as produits_count,\n                        -- Garder seulement le place_id de Google Places\n                        s.data->'google_place'->>'place_id' as google_place_id\n                    FROM services s\n                    WHERE s.user_id = $1\n                    ORDER BY s.created_at DESC\n                    LIMIT 200\n                    \n","rows_affected":23,"rows_returned":23,"elapsed":"1.344700052s","elapsed_secs":1.3447000519999999,"slow_threshold":"1s"},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-27T18:55:15.603293Z","level":"WARN","fields":{"message":"slow statement: execution time exceeded alert threshold","summary":"SELECT s.id, s.is_active, s.created_at, …","db.statement":"\n\n\n                    SELECT \n                        s.id,\n                        s.is_active,\n                        s.created_at,\n                        s.category,\n                        -- Extraire titre_service (support des deux formats)\n                        COALESCE(\n                            s.data->>'titre_service',\n                            s.data->'titre_service'->>'valeur',\n                            s.data->>'titre',\n                            'Service sans titre'\n                        ) as titre_service,\n                        -- Extraire description (tronquée à 200 caractères pour la liste)\n                        LEFT(\n                            COALESCE(\n                                s.data->>'description',\n                                s.data->'description'->>'valeur',\n                                ''\n                            ),\n                            200\n                        ) as description_preview,\n                        -- ✅ CORRIGÉ: Optimisation requête SQL - Utiliser LATERAL JOIN au lieu de sous-requête corrélée\n                        -- Cela évite l'exécution répétée de la sous-requête pour chaque service\n                        COALESCE(\n                            (\n                                SELECT jsonb_agg(\n                                    jsonb_build_object(\n                                        'nom', COALESCE(p.product->>'nom', p.product->>'name', p.product->>'titre', ''),\n                                        'prix', p.product->>'prix',\n                                        'devise', p.product->>'devise',\n                                        'is_active', COALESCE(pl.is_active, true)\n                                    )\n                                    ORDER BY p.idx\n                                )\n                                FROM LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(\n                                    CASE \n                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                        ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                    END\n                                ) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(product, idx)\n                                LEFT JOIN products_lifecycle pl \n                                    ON pl.service_id = s.id AND pl.product_index = p.idx - 1\n                                LIMIT 10\n                            ),\n                            '[]'::jsonb\n                        ) as produits_light,\n                        -- Compter les produits (réutilise le parsing ci-dessus via jsonb_array_length qui est très rapide)\n                        -- ✅ CORRECTION: Caster explicitement en BIGINT pour correspondre au type Rust Option<i64>\n                        COALESCE(\n                            jsonb_array_length(\n                                CASE \n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                END\n                            )::BIGINT,\n                            0\n                        ) as produits_count,\n                        -- Garder seulement le place_id de Google Places\n                        s.data->'google_place'->>'place_id' as google_place_id\n                    FROM services s\n                    WHERE s.user_id = $1\n                    ORDER BY s.created_at DESC\n                    LIMIT 200\n                    \n","rows_affected":23,"rows_returned":23,"elapsed":"2.286301054s","elapsed_secs":2.286301054,"slow_threshold":"1s"},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-27T18:54:26.705223Z","level":"WARN","fields":{"message":"slow statement: execution time exceeded alert threshold","summary":"SELECT s.id, s.is_active, s.created_at, …","db.statement":"\n\n\n                    SELECT \n                        s.id,\n                        s.is_active,\n                        s.created_at,\n                        s.category,\n                        -- Extraire titre_service (support des deux formats)\n                        COALESCE(\n                            s.data->>'titre_service',\n                            s.data->'titre_service'->>'valeur',\n                            s.data->>'titre',\n                            'Service sans titre'\n                        ) as titre_service,\n                        -- Extraire description (tronquée à 200 caractères pour la liste)\n                        LEFT(\n                            COALESCE(\n                                s.data->>'description',\n                                s.data->'description'->>'valeur',\n                                ''\n                            ),\n                            200\n                        ) as description_preview,\n                        -- ✅ CORRIGÉ: Optimisation requête SQL - Utiliser LATERAL JOIN au lieu de sous-requête corrélée\n                        -- Cela évite l'exécution répétée de la sous-requête pour chaque service\n                        COALESCE(\n                            (\n                                SELECT jsonb_agg(\n                                    jsonb_build_object(\n                                        'nom', COALESCE(p.product->>'nom', p.product->>'name', p.product->>'titre', ''),\n                                        'prix', p.product->>'prix',\n                                        'devise', p.product->>'devise',\n                                        'is_active', COALESCE(pl.is_active, true)\n                                    )\n                                    ORDER BY p.idx\n                                )\n                                FROM LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(\n                                    CASE \n                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                        ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                    END\n                                ) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(product, idx)\n                                LEFT JOIN products_lifecycle pl \n                                    ON pl.service_id = s.id AND pl.product_index = p.idx - 1\n                                LIMIT 10\n                            ),\n                            '[]'::jsonb\n                        ) as produits_light,\n                        -- Compter les produits (réutilise le parsing ci-dessus via jsonb_array_length qui est très rapide)\n                        -- ✅ CORRECTION: Caster explicitement en BIGINT pour correspondre au type Rust Option<i64>\n                        COALESCE(\n                            jsonb_array_length(\n                                CASE \n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                END\n                            )::BIGINT,\n                            0\n                        ) as produits_count,\n                        -- Garder seulement le place_id de Google Places\n                        s.data->'google_place'->>'place_id' as google_place_id\n                    FROM services s\n                    WHERE s.user_id = $1\n                    ORDER BY s.created_at DESC\n                    LIMIT 200\n                    \n","rows_affected":23,"rows_returned":23,"elapsed":"1.927937127s","elapsed_secs":1.9279371269999999,"slow_threshold":"1s"},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-27T18:54:12.309281Z","level":"WARN","fields":{"message":"slow statement: execution time exceeded alert threshold","summary":"SELECT s.id, s.is_active, s.created_at, …","db.statement":"\n\n\n                    SELECT \n                        s.id,\n                        s.is_active,\n                        s.created_at,\n                        s.category,\n                        -- Extraire titre_service (support des deux formats)\n                        COALESCE(\n                            s.data->>'titre_service',\n                            s.data->'titre_service'->>'valeur',\n                            s.data->>'titre',\n                            'Service sans titre'\n                        ) as titre_service,\n                        -- Extraire description (tronquée à 200 caractères pour la liste)\n                        LEFT(\n                            COALESCE(\n                                s.data->>'description',\n                                s.data->'description'->>'valeur',\n                                ''\n                            ),\n                            200\n                        ) as description_preview,\n                        -- ✅ CORRIGÉ: Optimisation requête SQL - Utiliser LATERAL JOIN au lieu de sous-requête corrélée\n                        -- Cela évite l'exécution répétée de la sous-requête pour chaque service\n                        COALESCE(\n                            (\n                                SELECT jsonb_agg(\n                                    jsonb_build_object(\n                                        'nom', COALESCE(p.product->>'nom', p.product->>'name', p.product->>'titre', ''),\n                                        'prix', p.product->>'prix',\n                                        'devise', p.product->>'devise',\n                                        'is_active', COALESCE(pl.is_active, true)\n                                    )\n                                    ORDER BY p.idx\n                                )\n                                FROM LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(\n                                    CASE \n                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                        ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                    END\n                                ) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(product, idx)\n                                LEFT JOIN products_lifecycle pl \n                                    ON pl.service_id = s.id AND pl.product_index = p.idx - 1\n                                LIMIT 10\n                            ),\n                            '[]'::jsonb\n                        ) as produits_light,\n                        -- Compter les produits (réutilise le parsing ci-dessus via jsonb_array_length qui est très rapide)\n                        -- ✅ CORRECTION: Caster explicitement en BIGINT pour correspondre au type Rust Option<i64>\n                        COALESCE(\n                            jsonb_array_length(\n                                CASE \n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                END\n                            )::BIGINT,\n                            0\n                        ) as produits_count,\n                        -- Garder seulement le place_id de Google Places\n                        s.data->'google_place'->>'place_id' as google_place_id\n                    FROM services s\n                    WHERE s.user_id = $1\n                    ORDER BY s.created_at DESC\n                    LIMIT 200\n                    \n","rows_affected":23,"rows_returned":23,"elapsed":"1.820295867s","elapsed_secs":1.820295867,"slow_threshold":"1s"},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-27T18:53:30.403921Z","level":"WARN","fields":{"message":"slow statement: execution time exceeded alert threshold","summary":"WITH recent_trend AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        WITH recent_trend AS (\n            SELECT \n                ac.id,\n                ac.product_vector,\n                ac.usage_count as current_usage,\n                -- Calcul tendance : usage_count actuel vs il y a 7 jours (via updated_at)\n                CASE \n                    WHEN ac.updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' \n                    THEN 1 -- Tendance hausse (produit actif récemment)\n                    ELSE 0 -- Stable/baisse\n                END as is_trending\n            FROM autocomplete_combinations ac\n            WHERE ac.usage_count >= 2\n        )\n        SELECT \n            ac.product_vector,\n            ac.product_labels,\n            ac.usage_count,\n            ac.prix::FLOAT8 AS prix_float,\n            ac.has_variant,\n            ac.variant_dimension,\n            ac.variant_value,\n            rt.is_trending\n        FROM autocomplete_combinations ac\n        INNER JOIN recent_trend rt ON rt.id = ac.id\n        WHERE \n            -- Recherche dans le vecteur produit (ANY permet de chercher dans l'array)\n            EXISTS (\n                SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ac.product_vector) AS val\n                WHERE val ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'\n            )\n            -- Seulement les produits avec usage_count >= 2 (vraiment populaires)\n            AND ac.usage_count >= 2\n        ORDER BY \n            rt.is_trending DESC,  -- Tendances EN PREMIER\n            ac.usage_count DESC,  -- Puis popularité\n            ac.prix::FLOAT8 ASC           -- Puis prix\n        LIMIT $2\n        \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"7.300485245s","elapsed_secs":7.300485245,"slow_threshold":"1s"},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-27T18:53:27.303883Z","level":"WARN","fields":{"message":"slow statement: execution time exceeded alert threshold","summary":"WITH recent_trend AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        WITH recent_trend AS (\n            SELECT \n                ac.id,\n                ac.product_vector,\n                ac.usage_count as current_usage,\n                -- Calcul tendance : usage_count actuel vs il y a 7 jours (via updated_at)\n                CASE \n                    WHEN ac.updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' \n                    THEN 1 -- Tendance hausse (produit actif récemment)\n                    ELSE 0 -- Stable/baisse\n                END as is_trending\n            FROM autocomplete_combinations ac\n            WHERE ac.usage_count >= 2\n        )\n        SELECT \n            ac.product_vector,\n            ac.product_labels,\n            ac.usage_count,\n            ac.prix::FLOAT8 AS prix_float,\n            ac.has_variant,\n            ac.variant_dimension,\n            ac.variant_value,\n            rt.is_trending\n        FROM autocomplete_combinations ac\n        INNER JOIN recent_trend rt ON rt.id = ac.id\n        WHERE \n            -- Recherche dans le vecteur produit (ANY permet de chercher dans l'array)\n            EXISTS (\n                SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ac.product_vector) AS val\n                WHERE val ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'\n            )\n            -- Seulement les produits avec usage_count >= 2 (vraiment populaires)\n            AND ac.usage_count >= 2\n        ORDER BY \n            rt.is_trending DESC,  -- Tendances EN PREMIER\n            ac.usage_count DESC,  -- Puis popularité\n            ac.prix::FLOAT8 ASC           -- Puis prix\n        LIMIT $2\n        \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"5.103993022s","elapsed_secs":5.103993022,"slow_threshold":"1s"},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-27T18:53:22.802883Z","level":"WARN","fields":{"message":"slow statement: execution time exceeded alert threshold","summary":"WITH recent_trend AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        WITH recent_trend AS (\n            SELECT \n                ac.id,\n                ac.product_vector,\n                ac.usage_count as current_usage,\n                -- Calcul tendance : usage_count actuel vs il y a 7 jours (via updated_at)\n                CASE \n                    WHEN ac.updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' \n                    THEN 1 -- Tendance hausse (produit actif récemment)\n                    ELSE 0 -- Stable/baisse\n                END as is_trending\n            FROM autocomplete_combinations ac\n            WHERE ac.usage_count >= 2\n        )\n        SELECT \n            ac.product_vector,\n            ac.product_labels,\n            ac.usage_count,\n            ac.prix::FLOAT8 AS prix_float,\n            ac.has_variant,\n            ac.variant_dimension,\n            ac.variant_value,\n            rt.is_trending\n        FROM autocomplete_combinations ac\n        INNER JOIN recent_trend rt ON rt.id = ac.id\n        WHERE \n            -- Recherche dans le vecteur produit (ANY permet de chercher dans l'array)\n            EXISTS (\n                SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ac.product_vector) AS val\n                WHERE val ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'\n            )\n            -- Seulement les produits avec usage_count >= 2 (vraiment populaires)\n            AND ac.usage_count >= 2\n        ORDER BY \n            rt.is_trending DESC,  -- Tendances EN PREMIER\n            ac.usage_count DESC,  -- Puis popularité\n            ac.prix::FLOAT8 ASC           -- Puis prix\n        LIMIT $2\n        \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"6.301426087s","elapsed_secs":6.301426087,"slow_threshold":"1s"},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-27T18:53:21.504686Z","level":"WARN","fields":{"message":"slow statement: execution time exceeded alert threshold","summary":"WITH recent_trend AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        WITH recent_trend AS (\n            SELECT \n                ac.id,\n                ac.product_vector,\n                ac.usage_count as current_usage,\n                -- Calcul tendance : usage_count actuel vs il y a 7 jours (via updated_at)\n                CASE \n                    WHEN ac.updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' \n                    THEN 1 -- Tendance hausse (produit actif récemment)\n                    ELSE 0 -- Stable/baisse\n                END as is_trending\n            FROM autocomplete_combinations ac\n            WHERE ac.usage_count >= 2\n        )\n        SELECT \n            ac.product_vector,\n            ac.product_labels,\n            ac.usage_count,\n            ac.prix::FLOAT8 AS prix_float,\n            ac.has_variant,\n            ac.variant_dimension,\n            ac.variant_value,\n            rt.is_trending\n        FROM autocomplete_combinations ac\n        INNER JOIN recent_trend rt ON rt.id = ac.id\n        WHERE \n            -- Recherche dans le vecteur produit (ANY permet de chercher dans l'array)\n            EXISTS (\n                SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ac.product_vector) AS val\n                WHERE val ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'\n            )\n            -- Seulement les produits avec usage_count >= 2 (vraiment populaires)\n            AND ac.usage_count >= 2\n        ORDER BY \n            rt.is_trending DESC,  -- Tendances EN PREMIER\n            ac.usage_count DESC,  -- Puis popularité\n            ac.prix::FLOAT8 ASC           -- Puis prix\n        LIMIT $2\n        \n","rows_affected":8,"rows_returned":8,"elapsed":"6.204693911s","elapsed_secs":6.204693911,"slow_threshold":"1s"},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-27T18:53:07.637785Z","level":"WARN","fields":{"message":"slow statement: execution time exceeded alert threshold","summary":"WITH recent_trend AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        WITH recent_trend AS (\n            SELECT \n                ac.id,\n                ac.product_vector,\n                ac.usage_count as current_usage,\n                -- Calcul tendance : usage_count actuel vs il y a 7 jours (via updated_at)\n                CASE \n                    WHEN ac.updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' \n                    THEN 1 -- Tendance hausse (produit actif récemment)\n                    ELSE 0 -- Stable/baisse\n                END as is_trending\n            FROM autocomplete_combinations ac\n            WHERE ac.usage_count >= 2\n        )\n        SELECT \n            ac.product_vector,\n            ac.product_labels,\n            ac.usage_count,\n            ac.prix::FLOAT8 AS prix_float,\n            ac.has_variant,\n            ac.variant_dimension,\n            ac.variant_value,\n            rt.is_trending\n        FROM autocomplete_combinations ac\n        INNER JOIN recent_trend rt ON rt.id = ac.id\n        WHERE \n            -- Recherche dans le vecteur produit (ANY permet de chercher dans l'array)\n            EXISTS (\n                SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ac.product_vector) AS val\n                WHERE val ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'\n            )\n            -- Seulement les produits avec usage_count >= 2 (vraiment populaires)\n            AND ac.usage_count >= 2\n        ORDER BY \n            rt.is_trending DESC,  -- Tendances EN PREMIER\n            ac.usage_count DESC,  -- Puis popularité\n            ac.prix::FLOAT8 ASC           -- Puis prix\n        LIMIT $2\n        \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.710495322s","elapsed_secs":1.7104953219999999,"slow_threshold":"1s"},"target":"sqlx::query"}
